summary: Catálogo y conocimiento vivo del negocio (productos, precios, IVA, equipo, preguntas frecuentes e instrucciones) con propuestas, lectura de confirmación en español, revisiones encadenadas y snapshots firmados por checksum para sincronizar asistentes.
invariants: Imports nothing outside its folder (only node: built-ins).
A change is never applied without an explicit approval reference; proposals only describe it.
History is append-only: retiring an entry never deletes it.
Text that looks like a secret or an attempt to override assistant rules is rejected, never stored.
Snapshots contain only entries visible to the requested audience and carry a deterministic SHA-256 checksum.
A consumer counts as synchronized only when it reports the same revision AND checksum.
reuseNotes: Import from src/index.ts. The host product owns persistence (Janus stores revisions in SQLite through an adapter), approvals and the publication channel. Feed utterances through parseSpanishUtterance + resolveIntent; apply with applyChanges once the host has an approval.
